cases.input: The realization window closes but the final qualified observation arrives later with a separate phenomenon period and result time.
cases.expect: The benefit remains measurement-pending until evidence arrives, then records partial or full realization without rewriting timing history.

cases.input: Two projects claim 0.4 and 0.5 of one benefit for the same period and the authority adjudicates both.
cases.expect: Both claims are retained and the adjudicated total of 0.9 is valid.

cases.input: Retention improves while support contacts rise and no commensuration method exists.
cases.expect: The benefit and disbenefit remain separate labelled dimensions with their own evidence and attribution.

cases.input: A project marks a deliverable complete and automatically sets the customer outcome to realised.
cases.expect: The realization is rejected because deliverable completion is not outcome evidence.

cases.input: Two projects claim adjudicated shares of 0.6 and 0.5 for the same benefit and period.
cases.expect: Both claims remain unreconciled until the non-overlapping total is at most one.

cases.input: No measurement exists and the realised benefit value is stored as zero.
cases.expect: The value is rejected and an explicit absent-measurement reason is required.

cases.input: A metric definition changes and an existing target silently adopts the new baseline.
cases.expect: The target is invalid until an explicit methodological restatement creates a traceable revision.
